instructions.schwa_retention_error: Do not pronounce an explicit vowel at the end of the word. Standard Hindi drops the final schwa.
instructions.aspiration_missing: This consonant requires an audible burst of breath (aspiration).
instructions.dental_vs_retroflex: Adjust tongue contact point: dental sounds touch upper teeth; retroflex sounds touch the palate.
instructions.nukta_missing: This loan sound requires frication: pronounce /z/ not /d͡ʒ/, or /f/ not /pʰ/.
